title: Design System: Iyad Mahdy Portfolio (Line Map)

billboard.purpose: Hero name only; Archivo 900 at wdth 112.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: System is flat; Bootstrap shadow utilities are zeroed.

shadows.name: lit-ring
shadows.purpose: Hard ring (no blur) around a numeral when a skill lights its line.

motion.name: station-draw
motion.purpose: Route stroke draws in on scroll; paused until the line enters view.

motion.name: dim
motion.purpose: Unmatched lines when a skill is selected.

components.name: Sign Button
components.description: Primary call to action in a line colour with ink border.
components.html: Resume Projects Contact
components.css: .ds-sign { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:0.8rem 1.4rem; border:2px solid var(--ink,#111418); border-radius:6px; font-weight:800; font-size:1.05rem; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-sign--1 { background:var(--l1,#0b4fd6); color:#fff; } .ds-sign--2 { background:var(--ink,#111418); color:#fff; } .ds-sign--3 { background:var(--l3,#f2b200); color:var(--ink,#111418); } .ds-sign:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-sign:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink,#111418); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Toggle that lights every line using the skill.
components.css: .ds-chip { font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; border:2px solid var(--ink,#111418); background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#111418); border-radius:999px; padding:0.35rem 0.95rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.15s,color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background:var(--mist,#f1f2f4); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--ink,#111418); color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink,#111418); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Row with Stations
components.description: Numeral circle plus a stroke of stations, one per pipeline stage.
components.css: .ds-line { --line:var(--l1,#0b4fd6); display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; column-gap:1.25rem; padding-block:1.75rem; } .ds-num { width:4.5rem; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--line); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:900; font-size:2.5rem; font-stretch:110%; } .ds-name { font-weight:900; font-size:1.5rem; margin:0; } .ds-stations { list-style:none; margin:1.25rem 0 0; padding:0; display:flex; } .ds-stations li { position:relative; flex:1 1 0; padding:1.6rem 0.5rem 0 0; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-stations li::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:1.1rem; height:1.1rem; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; border:4px solid var(--line); z-index:1; } .ds-stations li::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:1.1rem; right:0; top:0.4rem; height:0.3rem; background:var(--line); } .ds-stations li:last-child::after { display:none; } .ds-stations li:last-child::before { width:1.4rem; height:1.4rem; top:-0.15rem; border-width:5px; border-color:var(--ink,#111418); background:var(--line); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Flat white panel with 2px ink outline.
components.css: .ds-card { border:2px solid var(--ink,#111418); border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#111418); padding:1.25rem; } .ds-card p { margin:0.5rem 0 0; color:var(--muted,#4a5058); }

components.name: Top Bar Navigation
components.description: Ink bar with brand and tabs; active tab is inverted.
components.html: Iyad MahdyHomeProjectsResume
components.css: .ds-bar { background:var(--ink,#111418); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.25rem; padding:0.75rem 1.5rem; } .ds-brand { color:#fff; font-weight:900; font-stretch:112%; font-size:1.25rem; margin-right:auto; } .ds-tab { color:#fff; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; padding:0.4rem 0.9rem; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-tab:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16); } .ds-tab.ds-active { background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#111418); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--l3,#f2b200); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Next-stop Bar
components.description: Amber strip pointing to the next page.
components.css: .ds-next { background:var(--l3,#f2b200); border-top:2px solid var(--ink,#111418); } .ds-next a { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; padding:1.5rem; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink,#111418); } .ds-next span { font-weight:700; } .ds-next strong { font-size:2rem; font-weight:900; font-stretch:112%; } .ds-next a:hover strong { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:4px; }

narrative.overview: Each AI system is a coloured route line and each pipeline stage is a station, read at a glance like station signage. The ground is a white sign panel, the bars are ink black, and every line owns one saturated colour: blue for SmartCA, magenta for Kidic, amber for Nexora, green for analysis work. The system stays recognisable with all copy removed, because the route strokes and station dots carry it.
keyCharacteristics: White panels, ink bars, four line colours used as identity, not decoration.
2px ink borders with small radii (4 to 8px); no shadows, no gradients.
Archivo variable font: wide and heavy for signs, normal width for reading.
Line numerals as large filled circles; stations as ringed dots on a thick stroke.
One signature interaction: choosing a skill lights the lines that use it and dims the rest.

rules.name: The One Line, One Colour Rule
rules.body: A line colour identifies its system everywhere: numeral, stations, tags, inner-page heading badge. It is never reused as a generic accent for another system.

rules.name: The Ink Text on Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber fills carry ink text and ink numerals; amber never sets text on white.

rules.name: The Wide Sign, Normal Text Rule
rules.body: Widened font-stretch is reserved for sign-level text (names, titles, numerals, 404 code); running text stays at 100%.

rules.name: The Flat Sign Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat panels with ink outlines. State is shown by fill inversion, a ring, opacity (dim to 0.3) or a 2px lift on sign buttons, never by shadow.

dos: Do use the four line colours as system identity and keep one colour per system.
Do use 2px ink borders with 4, 6 or 8px radii on every panel, button and field.
Do pair amber fills with ink text and keep focus outlines at 3px with offset.
Do keep line colour as a CSS variable (--line) so numerals, stations and links inherit it.
Do respect reduced motion by disabling the station draw and the button lift.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or glow; the template's gradient and shadow utilities are deliberately neutralised.
Don't set body text in widened or black Archivo, or use the wide cut outside sign-level text.
Don't use amber as text on white or any line colour for decoration unrelated to its system.
Don't use icon-card grids; the stage list, not icon tiles, is how process is shown.
